topics.summary: Define the unit of work and its deadline. Record the admitted arrival rate, queue capacities, overload behavior, allocation policy after steady state begins, synchronization points, and external dependencies that can block progress. Distinguish hard requirements from engineering targets. General-purpose operating systems and ordinary GPU execution do not become hard real-time merely because a benchmark usually finishes quickly.
